hook: Heavy, frantic pounding at the door in the pouring rain immediately creates high tension and urgency.
cliffhanger: The mother reveals her boy has been burning with fever since yesterday morning and barely eating, leaving his survival in doubt.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand that a desperate mother is seeking medical help for her dying child from the cottage residents.
narrative_context: A frantic mother arrives at the woodland cottage seeking help for her dangerously ill child.
promotional_strength: The sudden intrusion and high-stakes medical emergency create instant emotional engagement and dramatic tension.

evidence.observation: Heavy, frantic pounding shatters the quiet inside the cottage.
The distraught mother pleads for help for her burning boy.
The mother explains the severity of the child's condition.

logline: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy, frantic pounding echoes against the heavy wooden cottage door.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana stops grinding and lifts her head sharply toward the entrance in alarm.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Alexander turning toward the doorway, his eyes sharp and vigilant.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Protective)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Stay back. I'll open it.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander steps forward and unlatches the cottage door, opening it into the pouring rain.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot framing the doorway as a soaked, distraught peasant mother steps across the threshold clutching a swaddled child.

source_segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Frantic, Weeping)
source_segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
source_segments.text: Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana rushing to the front of the table, extending her arms urgently.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent, Compassionate)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Bring him here. Quickly.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The trembling mother gently lays the feverish boy down atop the wooden table as Juliana leans in close.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana gently placing her fingers against the boy's burning forehead.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana examining the boy's breathing, looking up toward the frantic mother.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Reassuring, Focused)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of Alexander watching anxiously over the child's shoulder as Juliana tends to him.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the peasant mother clutching her shawl, tears running down her cheeks.

source_segments.label: PEASANT MOTHER (Trembling, Anxious)
source_segments.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
source_segments.text: Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset.

hook: A former groom brings a hushed warning about a war veteran resembling the late Duke, immediately capturing attention with a major secret.
cliffhanger: The Blond Nobleman stares into the fire in mounting terror as creeping paranoia sets in.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can understand that a powerful nobleman is terrified upon hearing rumors of a scarred survivor.
narrative_context: The Blond Nobleman learns unsettling rumors about a scarred war veteran, sparking his underlying panic and paranoia.
promotional_strength: Reveals a high-stakes conspiracy and shifts the narrative focus to the antagonist's fear of Alexander's true identity.

evidence.observation: The former groom reports rumors of a war veteran resembling the late Duke.
Mentions the man has the same scar the Duke carried.
The Blond Nobleman is paralyzed by dark dread as flames dance across his eyes.

logline: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of The Former Groom, damp dark hair plastered to his forehead.

source_segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Hesitant, Deferential)
source_segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
source_segments.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman lowering his book, gazing across with mild annoyance.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Coldly Curious)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: What rumor?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of The Former Groom speaking cautiously.

source_segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Uneasy)
source_segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
source_segments.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman scoffing dismissively as he closes the book.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Mocking, Arrogant)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of The Former Groom's eyes widening with urgent dread.

source_segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Tense, Solemn)
source_segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
source_segments.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman snapping his head around, his smug expression freezing into sudden alarm.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sharp, Demanding)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Where?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of The Former Groom shifting uncomfortably.

source_segments.label: THE FORMER GROOM (Cautious)
source_segments.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
source_segments.text: No one seems certain.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Blond Nobleman composing his features into cold disdain, though tension trembles beneath his tone.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive, Masking Panic)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Then let it remain a rumor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as The Former Groom turns and retreats silently out of the study, leaving the doors closed.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Side profile shot of the Blond Nobleman seated alone before the roaring fire, staring blankly into the flames in creeping paranoia.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Whispering, Shaken)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Impossible.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up macro shot of the Blond Nobleman's eye, the flickering fireplace flames dancing across his widening iris as dark dread paralyzes him, holding until the screen cuts to black.
